sections.heading: Study and training support loans
sections.text:
Explains income contingent loans for undertaking higher education, trade apprenticeships and other training programs.

A brief overview of how study and training support loans work, including a video.

You can find a number of loans available from the Australian Government to help you complete further training and study.

How to use the ATO app or ATO online services to view your study or training support loan account.

You must start repaying your loan when your repayment income exceeds the minimum repayment income.

How to tell your employer about your study or training support loan, and why it's important.

How and when compulsory repayments of your study and training support loan are made through the income tax system.

You can make voluntary repayments at any time to help reduce your study or training loan balance.

Provide an overseas travel notification and report your worldwide income if you have a study or training support loan.

You may apply to defer your compulsory repayment or overseas levy if you're in serious hardship or for other reasons.

See changes related to any new legislation for student and training support debts.
